who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113; reported by the lane reapproof (claude-opus-5-5)
where: lean/Blaze/Auto.lean, the tactic blaze_auto, on the reap`s theorem (crates/blaze-core/lean/BlazeCore/Wait/Reaping.lean)
what: blaze_auto closed nothing of a theorem that three plain `simp`s over a 32-case split then closed in 2.5 s: (1) without `open Std.WP Lean.Order` at the call site it fails with `failed to synthesize Std.WP.Assertion Prop`; (2) its vcgen stops with `No spec found for program no_child` at an opaque call that sits in a match arm no case takes; (3) it never case-splits on `Option`/`Bool` arguments, pushes the matches into large `if` terms and grind leaves them; (4) after a manual split, all 32 cases in one call hit the 200000 heartbeat limit.
cost: about four builds of a proof lane; the proof was written by hand instead
cause: blaze_auto was shaped on arithmetic and loop goals (busy, clock); a finite case analysis over enum-valued arguments and code with opaque calls is another kind of goal
whys: the tactic the how-to says to try first did not help on the simplest theorem of the day
it has no step that splits the theorem`s arguments by their constructors before generating conditions
vcgen needs a spec for every call it meets, reachable or not, and opaque functions have none
class: automation tuned on the goals it was written against, with no measure of which goal kinds it closes
prevention: blaze_auto opens what it needs itself; splits arguments of finite types (Bool, Option, enums of the crate) first, bounded; gets a `False`-precondition spec for each opaque function from the translator (or skips arms simp has closed); and a small corpus of the tree`s proved theorems is rerun with `blaze_auto` alone, the count of those it closes kept in the ledger (V13). Not built.
workaround: case-split by hand, then `simp` with the model`s definitions, one lemma per stage
fix: by the lane autotac (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-14: blaze_auto opens what it needs, unfolds the reachable models with no list, splits Bool/Option/Result and small enums (64 cases at most, each closed on its own budget), and gives every reached opaque call a spec with precondition False. lean/Blaze/Tests/AutoCorpus.lean measures it: 23 of 27 of the tree`s theorems closed by bare `blaze_auto` (1 before as stated, 13 with hand lists). Still open, another class: `forall args, exists fuel` over a loop (it needs the fuel as a term and the invariant) and a bound on a power.
